text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% on the day and 3.02% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day +2.93%). Advances outpaced declines (401 vs 92) and the breadth score stayed neutral at 44.5, indicating a fairly wide‑range rally. The India VIX, a volatility gauge, ticked higher to 15.5 (+1.31%), suggesting modest uncertainty despite the gains.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding about ₹3,115 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold roughly ₹392 crore, giving a net inflow of around ₹2,723 crore. The leading sectors were Pharma, Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Healthcare, PSU Bank and Commodities, whereas IT, Media and Private Bank stocks showed weakening. In options, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.66, with a max‑pain level at 23,250 and an expected range of 23,293‑23,589; the call wall sits at 24,000 and the put wall at 23,000. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.96, max‑pain 55,500 and expected range 53,701‑56,304, with a call wall at 57,000 and put wall at 58,000.

Watch the 23,284 S1, 23,363 P and 23,519 R1 Nifty 50 pivots for support/resistance, and the 54,707 S1, 54,877 P and 55,172 R1 Bank Nifty levels. Key headlines to monitor include Q2 earnings from ITC, Marico and Reliance, the IPO fund‑raise of ₹84,400 crore, and global cues such as China’s market‑stabilisation moves, which could influence foreign flows into the next session.
